character_facts: The silver-haired man is capable of advanced biological or surgical intervention.
He appears compassionate or curious enough to preserve the creature's life and converse with it.
The small robot functions as an assistant during the treatment and remains present during the exchange.
Aghnar is initially weak and wounded but recovers quickly enough to stand, speak, and leap away.
Aghnar is intelligent, verbally expressive, and not interested in staying once restored.
characters_present: Silver-haired male narrator/healer with a metal foot
Ape-like rational creature later named Aghnar
Mentioned but not shown directly: the young lord
continuity_links: The narrator explicitly connects this event to helping a young lord, implying the healing has relevance to a larger ongoing storyline.
This page appears to depict the origin or first naming of Aghnar.
dialogue_meaning: The narrator frames the episode as part of his service to a young lord and emphasizes the difficulty of creating green blood for the treatment.
The wounded creature proves it can think and speak, startling the narrator.
The creature questions the motive behind being revived and interprets the act as possible companionship.
It describes anatomical features in its throat and body and says its current mode of life is unsuitable.
The narrator proposes altering the creature so it can float rather than remain bound to the ground.
The naming of the creature, Aghnar, becomes the emotional culmination of the exchange before it leaves.
locations: A medical or laboratory interior filled with surgical machinery
An open platform or threshold leading outside, where the creature departs
lore_facts: Synthesized green blood exists and can be used medically to save a being with severe throat damage.
The healed ape-like being is a rational organism capable of speech.
The silver-haired man has a metal foot, explicitly noted by the creature.
The creature has unusual anatomy including throat sacs, floating glands, and bones that the man believes can receive an epiphyte-related injection.
The creature is named Aghnar on this page.
plot_events: The narrator says he helped a young lord by healing a creature with a torn throat using synthesized green blood.
In a lab-like room, the man and a small robot treat a large wounded ape-like being laid out among machinery.
The creature regains speech and surprises the narrator by revealing itself to be rational and self-aware.
The creature asks why the metal-footed man gave it life and suggests he may want a bio-companion.
The creature describes aspects of its body and says life on the ground does not suit it.
The man offers another bodily modification or treatment so the creature can float forever.
The creature expresses gratitude and asks whether the man has named it.
The man names the creature Aghnar.
Immediately after being named, the creature leaps away into the open air, and the man protests that it is leaving.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the silver-haired narrator is not stated on this page.
The exact species or classification of Aghnar is unclear beyond being described visually as ape-like and verbally as rational.
Some technical terms in the dialogue, especially the treatment details, may be slightly uncertain due to small text size.
visual_summary: A silver-haired man recounts how he saved a wounded ape-like being inside a medical or laboratory chamber, assisted by a small robot and surrounded by machinery. After recovering enough to speak, the creature explains its injuries and condition, receives a name from the man, then immediately leaps away into the open exterior while the man calls after it.
